newsitem.title: USA: CBOT Sept T-bond futures expand losses, down a pt.
newsitem.headline: CBOT Sept T-bond futures expand losses, down a pt.

text.p: September U.S. Treasury bond futures traded at the Chicago Board of Trade expanded early losses and were off more than one full point.

The contract tumbled further after stronger-than-expected July data from the National Association of Purchasing Management. That index rose to 58.6 versus forecasts for 56.1. Most components, including the prices index, rose.
Futures sliced below supports near Thursday's low at 116-04/32 and Wednesday's low at 115-26/32.
September T-bonds fell initially Friday on strong July U.S. payrolls before cutting losses on benign hourly wages. ((DerivativesDesk(312)408-8750)) E-mail:derivatives@reuters.com
